sloka: प्रीतो ऽस्मि तव वीर्यस्य शौण्डार्याच्च दशानन ।शैलाक्रान्तेन यो मुक्तस्त्वया रावः सुदारुणः ।। ७.१६.३७ ॥
transliteration: prīto 'smi tava vīryasya śauṇḍāryācca daśānana ।śailākrāntena yo muktastvayā rāvaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।। 7.16.37 ॥

translations.english: O ten-headed one, I am pleased with your valor and prowess, demonstrated by the very terrible cry you released while being crushed by the mountain.
